history_summary: Record three genus-reference correspondences and complete Fusibacter alternatives for TCP groundwater descriptors.
history_details: Actual native ground-and-status added Desulfovibrio551/592, Nitratidesulfovibrio17/30 and Parabacteroides15116/15122 reference-genus blocks, all three ordered Fusibacter alternatives, four statuses and two native inline events. The17/30 majority remains weak and rounded1.0 for15116/15122 does not mean unanimity. Preserve all four generic genus descriptors, absent strain assignments, exact source quotations, old notes, two interaction nodes, zero causal arrows and both open discussions. The retained abstract describes a hypothesized functional module, not demonstrated member-specific substrate transfer;19.06umol/L/day and3.5days remain culture-level endpoints without attributing the rate to every amendment or member. No full-text or supplementary study evidence was added. Crosswalk populations are not sample abundances or stock probabilities, release is unestablished and mtime is not a release. Source binding was authored locally and actual M5 application ran at cfa5f093. This bounded diagnostic does not complete scientific review, references, generated products or corpus QC.
